findings.obs_text: The heart is named as the place of the thoughts in Gen 6:5, Deu 15:9, 1Ch 29:18, Isa 10:7, Jer 4:14, Mat 9:4, Mat 15:19, Mar 7:21, Luk 1:51, Luk 2:35, Luk 5:22 and Dan 7:28: the thoughts are of the heart, lodge within, come out of it, are kept in it, and are revealed from it.
findings.grounds: out of the heart come evil thoughts

findings.obs_text: In 1Ch 28:9, Psa 139:23 and Heb 4:12 the heart and the thoughts are searched and discerned together: the Lord tests every heart and grasps each plan, the psalmist asks God to know his heart and his thoughts, and the word discerns the thoughts and intentions of the heart.
findings.grounds: Search me, O God, and know my heart

findings.obs_text: The mind is named as where thoughts come in Eze 11:5, Eze 20:32, Eze 38:10 and Dan 2:30: the things that come into the mind, what is in the mind, thoughts that come into the mind and the thoughts of the king's mind.
findings.grounds: thoughts will come into your mind

findings.obs_text: In Rom 1:21 futile thinking goes with the foolish heart darkened, and in Jam 1:26 the one who thinks himself religious deceives his heart: the thinking and the state of the heart go together.
